name: Supporter Network - Gate Refused
description: The gate refusing a wrong passphrase: the error line shows and the field is cleared for another try, with none of the deck disclosed behind it. The only in-page failure state this view has, since nothing here fetches anything at runtime. It is worth capturing rather than assuming because the refusal path is where a gate silently fails open — the rule behind it also refuses an empty expected passphrase, which a bare string comparison would have admitted.
